examples.ar: يَجْتَهِدُ الطَّالِبُ لِيَنَالَ شَهَادَةَ التَّخَرُّجِ بِتَفَوُّقٍ.
examples.en: The student works hard to obtain the graduation certificate with distinction.
And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it.

examples.ar: طَبِيعَةُ الرِّيفِ الهَادِئَةُ تُسَاعِدُ عَلَى التَّأَمُّلِ.
examples.en: The quiet nature of the countryside helps in meditation.
Do not burden a soul except with its capacity.

examples.ar: نَامَ الطِّفْلُ الصَّغِيرُ بِهُدُوءٍ فِي مَهْدِهِ.
examples.en: The young child slept peacefully in his cradle.

translation: request, demand, seeking / also (طَلَبَ) he sought

examples.ar: طَلَبُ العِلْمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ.
examples.en: Seeking knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim.

examples.ar: طُمُوحِي العَالِي يَحْفِزُنِي عَلَى التَّعَلُّمِ المُسْتَمِرِّ.
examples.en: My high ambition motivates me to learn continuously.
